CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geography_publisher_document_lease(p_limit integer DEFAULT 4)
 RETURNS SETOF zoi.geography_repair_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE head zoi.geography_repair_jobs; cap integer:=greatest(least(coalesce(p_limit,4),4),1);
BEGIN
 -- Existing head admission owns host pacing, holds, expiry and generation checks.
 SELECT * INTO head FROM public.geography_publisher_lease(1);
 IF head.id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
 RETURN NEXT head;
 IF cap=1 THEN RETURN; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT j.id FROM zoi.geography_repair_jobs j
  WHERE j.strategy='publisher_profiles_v1' AND j.status IN('queued','leased')
  AND j.original->>'source_url'=head.original->>'source_url' AND j.id<>head.id
  AND (j.status='queued' OR (j.lease_expires_at<now() AND j.attempts<3))
  ORDER BY j.created_at,j.id LIMIT cap-1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
 ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.id,zoi.geography_source_job_current(j,l) AS current_input FROM picked p
  JOIN zoi.geography_repair_jobs j ON j.id=p.id JOIN zoi.listings l ON l.id=j.listing_id FOR SHARE OF l
 ), updated AS (
  UPDATE zoi.geography_repair_jobs j SET
   status=CASE WHEN c.current_input IS TRUE THEN 'leased' ELSE 'input_changed' END,
   reason=CASE WHEN c.current_input IS TRUE THEN j.reason ELSE 'listing_input_changed_before_capture' END,
   lease_id=CASE WHEN c.current_input IS TRUE THEN gen_random_uuid() ELSE NULL END,
   lease_expires_at=CASE WHEN c.current_input IS TRUE THEN now()+interval '15 minutes' ELSE NULL END,
   attempts=j.attempts+CASE WHEN c.current_input IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,updated_at=now()
  FROM checked c WHERE c.id=j.id RETURNING j.*
 ) SELECT * FROM updated WHERE status='leased';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geography_repair_lease(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_strategy text DEFAULT 'official_sources_v1'::text)
 RETURNS SETOF zoi.geography_repair_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_strategy IS NULL OR p_strategy NOT IN('official_sources_v1','publisher_profiles_v1') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported_geography_source_strategy';END IF;
 IF p_strategy='official_sources_v1' THEN
 UPDATE zoi.geography_repair_jobs SET status='unresolved',reason='capture_interrupted_three_times_requires_changed_strategy',lease_id=null,lease_expires_at=null,updated_at=now() WHERE strategy=p_strategy AND status='leased' AND lease_expires_at<now() AND attempts>=3;
 RETURN QUERY WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT j.id FROM zoi.geography_repair_jobs j WHERE j.strategy=p_strategy
 AND j.status IN('queued','leased')
 AND (j.status='queued' OR (j.lease_expires_at<now() AND j.attempts<3))
 ORDER BY j.created_at,j.id LIMIT greatest(least(coalesce(p_limit,10),30),1) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ),checked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT p.id,CASE WHEN zoi.geography_source_job_current(j,l) THEN j.input_fingerprint ELSE NULL END AS current_input FROM picked p
 JOIN zoi.geography_repair_jobs j ON j.id=p.id JOIN zoi.listings l ON l.id=j.listing_id FOR SHARE OF l
 ),updated AS (
 UPDATE zoi.geography_repair_jobs j SET
 status=CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN 'input_changed' ELSE 'leased' END,
 reason=CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN 'listing_input_changed_before_capture' ELSE j.reason END,
 lease_id=CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN NULL ELSE gen_random_uuid() END,
 lease_expires_at=CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN NULL ELSE now()+interval '15 minutes' END,
 attempts=j.attempts+CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,updated_at=now()
 FROM checked c WHERE c.id=j.id RETURNING j.*
 ) SELECT * FROM updated WHERE status='leased';
 ELSE
 UPDATE zoi.geography_repair_jobs SET status='unresolved',reason='capture_interrupted_three_times_requires_changed_strategy',lease_id=null,lease_expires_at=null,updated_at=now() WHERE strategy=p_strategy AND status='leased' AND lease_expires_at<now() AND attempts>=3;
 RETURN QUERY WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT j.id FROM zoi.geography_repair_jobs j WHERE j.strategy=p_strategy
 AND (j.strategy<>'publisher_profiles_v1' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM zoi.geography_publisher_host_holds h WHERE h.host=zoi.geography_publisher_host(j.original->>'source_url') AND h.blocked_until>now()))
 AND (j.strategy<>'publisher_profiles_v1' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM zoi.geography_repair_jobs peer WHERE peer.strategy='publisher_profiles_v1' AND peer.status IN('queued','leased') AND peer.id<>j.id AND peer.original->>'source_host'=j.original->>'source_host' AND ((peer.status='leased' AND peer.lease_expires_at>now()) OR (peer.status='queued' AND (peer.created_at,peer.id)<(j.created_at,j.id)))))
 AND j.status IN('queued','leased')
 AND (j.status='queued' OR (j.status='leased' AND j.lease_expires_at<now() AND j.attempts<3))
 ORDER BY j.created_at,j.id LIMIT greatest(least(coalesce(p_limit,10),30),1) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
 ),checked AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT p.id,CASE WHEN zoi.geography_source_job_current(j,l) THEN j.input_fingerprint ELSE NULL END AS current_input FROM picked p
 JOIN zoi.geography_repair_jobs j ON j.id=p.id JOIN zoi.listings l ON l.id=j.listing_id FOR SHARE OF l
 ),updated AS (
 UPDATE zoi.geography_repair_jobs j SET
 status=CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN 'input_changed' ELSE 'leased' END,
 reason=CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN 'listing_input_changed_before_capture' ELSE j.reason END,
 lease_id=CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN NULL ELSE gen_random_uuid() END,
 lease_expires_at=CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN NULL ELSE now()+interval '15 minutes' END,
 attempts=j.attempts+CASE WHEN j.input_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.current_input THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,updated_at=now()
 FROM checked c WHERE c.id=j.id RETURNING j.*
 ) SELECT * FROM updated WHERE status='leased';
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geography_source_archive_budget()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH usage AS(SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN metadata->>'size'~'^[0-9]+$'THEN(metadata->>'size')::numeric ELSE 0 END),0)AS bytes,count(*)FILTER(WHERE metadata->>'size'IS NULL OR metadata->>'size'!~'^[0-9]+$')AS unknown FROM storage.objects)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('can_archive',unknown=0 AND bytes+15000000<=536870912,'stored_bytes',bytes,'limit_bytes',536870912,'unknown_size_objects',unknown,'definition','All current Storage objects, capped at512MiB with15MB invocation reserve. Unmeasured object sizes block new leases.')FROM usage
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geography_source_capture_acquire(p_lease uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE claimed uuid;expiry timestamptz;BEGIN
 IF p_lease IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'capture_lease_required';END IF;
 UPDATE zoi.geography_source_capture_lock SET lease_id=p_lease,expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '180 seconds' WHERE singleton AND(expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at<=clock_timestamp())RETURNING lease_id,expires_at INTO claimed,expiry;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('acquired',claimed IS NOT NULL,'lease_id',claimed,'expires_at',expiry);
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geography_source_capture_release(p_lease uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE released uuid;BEGIN
 IF p_lease IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'capture_lease_required';END IF;
 UPDATE zoi.geography_source_capture_lock SET lease_id=NULL,expires_at=NULL WHERE singleton AND lease_id=p_lease RETURNING p_lease INTO released;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('released',released IS NOT NULL);
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, params jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, headers jsonb DEFAULT '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer DEFAULT 5000)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    request_id bigint;
    params_array text[];
    content_type text;
begin

    -- Exctract the content_type from headers
    select
        header_value into content_type
    from
        jsonb_each_text(coalesce(headers, '{}'::jsonb)) r(header_name, header_value)
    where
        lower(header_name) = 'content-type'
    limit
        1;

    -- If the user provided new headers and omitted the content type
    -- add it back in automatically
    if content_type is null then
        select headers || '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb into headers;
    end if;

    -- Confirm that the content-type is set as "application/json"
    if content_type <> 'application/json' then
        raise exception 'Content-Type header must be "application/json"';
    end if;

    select
        coalesce(array_agg(net._urlencode_string(key) || '=' || net._urlencode_string(value)), '{}')
    into
        params_array
    from
        jsonb_each_text(params);

    -- Add to the request queue
    insert into net.http_request_queue(method, url, headers, body, timeout_milliseconds)
    values (
        'POST',
        net._encode_url_with_params_array(url, params_array),
        headers,
        convert_to(body::text, 'UTF8'),
        timeout_milliseconds
    )
    returning id
    into request_id;

    perform net.wake();

    return request_id;
end
$function$
